_comment: Curated Mistral model catalog, read by MistralClient.ts. Ids, context windows and reasoning_effort levels are from docs.mistral.ai (models.md, inference/conversations/reasoning.md), checked 2026-11-11. thinking.default is OUR policy default, applied when the caller passes no --thinking; any documented level can be passed per call. kind 'none' means no reasoning_effort is sent (no documented control). bundle_tokens = context window minus a 100k output/reasoning reserve; the subscription's tokens-per-minute limits are undocumented, so this is a ceiling, not a measured budget.
